Eager to avoid getting in trouble again, he plastered his campus apartment with portraits of Mao and Hua Guofeng, the new Communist Party chairman after Mao’s death. 当我在1980年认识他时，他刚刚获得平反。他有了新妻子，并在大学里找到了一份教英语的新工作。为了避免再卷入麻烦，他在校园的公寓里贴满了毛泽东和华国锋的画像。华国锋是毛泽东去世后接任的中共中央主席。 He was alarmed when I told him that Hua’s portraits had suddenly disappeared from my lecture hall, a sure sign that he, too, had been purged. 当我告诉他，华国锋像突然从我的教室里消失时，他大为惊恐——这是华国锋也已被清洗的明确信号。 “It’s all so damn confusing,” he groaned. Lao Wen died in Jinan in 2001. “这一切真他妈的让人摸不着头脑，”他叹道。老温于2001年在济南去世。 詹姆斯·温纳瑞斯的墓碑。这名美国士兵在朝鲜战争结束后选择留在中国，2001年在济南去世。 His marble tombstone, paid for by his son, who moved to America, is in a serene new cemetery on the outskirts of Jinan. A gold inscription in English says he had not died, “just disappeared.” A Chinese inscription on the reverse side remembers him as an “American who loved peace, loved life and loved the people of China.” 他的儿子移居美国后，出资为他修建了一块大理石墓碑，墓地位于济南郊外一处宁静的新公墓。墓碑上的金色英文铭文写道，他并未离去，“只是消失了”。背面的中文铭文则称他是一位“热爱和平、热爱生活、热爱中国人民的美国人”。 His many travails are passed over in silence. 至于他生前遭遇的种种磨难，只字未提。 The silence that engulfs so much of China’s past reaches a sinister crescendo in Tiananmen Square, which I had last visited on the night of June 3-4, 1989, when soldiers seized it back from protesting students amid a hail of gunfire. 笼罩着中国诸多过去的沉默在天安门广场达到了令人胆寒的高潮。我上一次来到这里，是在1989年6月3日深夜至4日清晨，当时军队大肆开枪，从抗议学生手中强行夺回了广场。 By the time I left Beijing in 1991, roads around Tiananmen had all been repaved to remove traces of tank tracks. The square had again become a public space filled with people flying kites and playing with their children. 到1991年我离开北京时，天安门周围的道路都已重新铺设，抹去了坦克履带留下的痕迹。广场重新变回了公共空间，满是放风筝和带着孩子玩耍的民众。 Today, the Chinese capital’s main public square is no longer a place to relax like Red Square in Moscow or Trafalgar Square in London, but a by-appointment-only dead zone. Kites are banned without a permit. All visitors, mostly Chinese from the provinces, are carefully screened. 如今，这座中国首都的核心公共广场不再是像莫斯科红场或伦敦特拉法加广场那样令人放松的去处，而变成了一个仅限预约的死寂之地。未经许可严禁放风筝。所有访客——主要是来自外省的国内游客——都必须接受严格审查。 Before my wife and I could visit in January, we had to apply for permission via WeChat. Once approved, we waited in line for two hours, showing our passports and computer-generated permission notification at three separate checkpoints with airport-style security. 在今年1月前往游览之前，我和妻子必须提前通过微信提交申请。获得批准后，我们在三个配备了机场级安检设施的检查站排队等待了两个小时，出示护照和电子预约通知。 At the final check, a guard pounced on a pen carried by my wife, insisting it contained red ink, which she said was prohibited. She did not say why, but during the 1989 student protests several people hurled red paint at a famous portrait of Mao that faces the square. A security supervisor finally let us through after writing with the pen on a piece of paper and seeing that it was brown, not red. 在最后一道检查关口，一名安检员盯上了我妻子携带的一支笔，坚称笔芯装有红墨水，而红墨水是被禁止带入的。她没有解释原因，但在1989年学生抗议期间，曾有人向面向广场的那幅著名的毛泽东画像泼洒红色油漆。安检主管最终拿这支笔在纸上试写，确认墨水是褐色而非红色后，才放我们通行。 Now out of China, I often wonder: How can it be that a proud, nuclear-armed world power is scared of red ink? 如今离开中国后，我常常感到困惑：一个自豪且拥有核武器的世界大国，究竟为何会害怕一支装有红墨水的笔？ 摄影：Gilles Sabrié Andrew Higgins是时报东欧和中欧分社社长，常驻华沙。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
content: ANDREW HIGGINS 2026年10月12日 今年1月，时报记者安德鲁·希金斯乘车经过天安门广场。1989年6月，他曾亲历军队对抗议腐败、不平等和通货膨胀的民众展开武力镇压的现场。 It was an enjoyable day of temple and factory visits organized by China Daily, the Communist Party’s English-language mouthpiece, but it ended on an uncomfortable note. 那是中共官方英文媒体《中国日报》组织的一次令人愉快的寺庙与工厂探访之旅，结尾却令人颇感不适。 The group I was traveling with in the northern province of Shanxi — mostly foreign influencers hungry for followers and Chinese freebies — was told to line up behind a long banner and be filmed chanting: “Amazing China, Amazing Shanxi.” 与我一同前往北方省份山西的这群人主要是渴望粉丝和免费福利的外国网红，他们被要求在一条长横幅后排开，并对着镜头合唱：“Amazing China, Amazing Shanxi”（大美中国，大美山西）。 I declined to join in, scowling in silence. But, back in my hotel room in the provincial capital of Taiyuan, I felt I had perhaps been too churlish: Getting a bunch of foreigners to chant on cue for the camera about China’s wonders was a transparent but harmless propaganda stunt. 我拒绝配合，面带不悦地冷眼旁观。不过，回到省会太原的酒店房间后，我又觉得自己的态度或许过于生硬了：让一群外国人对着镜头按指令合唱对中国奇迹的赞歌，不过是个显而易见却也无害的宣传把戏而已。 And, to be honest, the 11th century temples we visited — and also the new highway that took us to them — were pretty amazing. 况且说实话，我们参观的11世纪古刹——以及把我们送到那里的新建高速公路——确实相当惊人。 Then I received a message on WeChat, a Chinese messaging app, from an old friend in Beijing, a lawyer whose earnest decency and movie star looks always reminded me of the “good party cadre” characters in propaganda films. I had not seen him for more than 30 years and was planning to visit the following day. 随后，我的微信收到了一条来自北京一位老朋友的信息。他是一名律师，为人真诚得体，长相如明星般英俊，总让我想起宣传电影里那些“优秀党员干部”形象。我已有30多年没见过他，本计划第二天去拜访他。 Sadly, his message said, he would not be able to keep our appointment because state security officers, somehow apprised of our plans, had turned up at his door and ordered him to cancel. 遗憾的是，他在信息中说自己无法赴约了，因为国家安全官员不知通过什么渠道获悉了我们的行程，直接找上了他的家门，命令他取消见面的计划。 China suddenly appeared not so much amazing as alarming. 一瞬间，中国带给我的不再是惊艳，而是惊恐。 After decades away from the country where I studied classical Chinese in 1980-81 and then worked as a journalist from 1987 until 1991, I returned in September last year for a six-month assignment. I marveled at how much had changed, sharing the amazement of first-time visitors awe-struck by China’s high-speed trains, dazzling modern cities and gung-ho embrace of the future. 我曾于1980至1981年间在中国学习古汉语，后于1987年至1991年担任驻华记者。在离开这个国家数十年后，我于去年9月返回中国执行为期六个月的报道任务。我惊叹于这里的巨变，和那些初次踏足这片土地的游客一样，我被中国的高铁网络、耀眼的现代都市以及对未来的热切拥抱所震撼。 1981年，戴着围巾的希金斯在山东大学食堂。当时，食堂只供应油乎乎的粥和馒头，粥里漂着几块不知是什么的肉。 My old friend’s message broke the reverie: 然而，我这位老友发来的消息打碎了这份美好： “Every bush and tree seems like an enemy soldier,” he warned, using a Chinese idiom to describe the paranoia of a security apparatus that has also changed dramatically. It has grown bigger, more intrusive and, thanks to high-tech marvels like WeChat and omnipresent surveillance cameras, much more capable of monitoring just about everyone. “草木皆兵，”他用这句中国成语提醒我，道出了如今安全机器的极度疑神疑鬼——这套机构自身同样经历了剧烈变化。它现在规模更大、侵入性更强；借助微信及无处不在的监控摄像头等高科技手段，它具备了对几乎所有人实施全天候监控的能力。 China’s economic transformation over the last four decades has been extraordinary, and it infuriates Chinese officials that Western media outlets display what they see as “anti-China bias.” That is shorthand for reporting that dwells on anxiety about the economy, still growing but at a slower pace, and anything else that deviates from China’s undeniable achievements and charms. 过去40年来，中国的经济转型无疑是卓越的，而西方媒体展现出的所谓“反华偏见“令中国官员极为恼火。所谓“反华偏见“，指的是那些着重渲染中国经济焦虑的报道—​​—尽管中国经济仍在增长，但增速放缓——以及任何与中国无可否认的成就和魅力相悖的内容。 Throughout my stay, I struggled to reconcile the reality of a country that has never been richer and seemingly full of promise with a parallel reality of brittle insecurity, in which every bush and tree hides a potential enemy. 在华停留期间，我一直在试图调和这种撕裂感：一方面，这个国家从未如此富裕，似乎充满希望；另一方面，它又存在着一种脆弱的安全感缺失，仿佛每一株草木背后都潜伏着未知的敌人。 Based in Shanghai , I often went on weekends with my wife to a park in the city’s northern Hongkou district, where groups of older Chinese gather to sing songs from their youth. Their favorite numbers are patriotic anthems but the singers, who often included a Uyghur man dressed and made up to look like Charlie Chaplin, were there of their own accord. 在上海期间 ，我和妻子经常在周末前往该市北部的虹口公园。那里聚集着许多中老年人，他们自发凑在一起演唱年轻时代的歌曲。他们最爱唱的是爱国歌曲——经常能看到其中有一位装扮成查理·卓别林的维吾尔族男子——但完全是出于自愿参与其中。 Their boisterous camaraderie and national pride seemed entirely genuine. 他们欢聚的热烈氛围与国家自豪感看起来完全出自真心。 An official sign nearby, however, clouded the carefree mood: “Opposing Traitors and Guarding Against Spies Starts With Us,” it warned, with a phone number to “report espionage activity.” 然而，附近挂着的一块官方告示牌却为这种无忧无虑的氛围蒙上了阴影，牌子上警告道：“反间防谍，从我做起，”并附上了“举报间谍行为”的电话号码。 The hunt for spies has escalated sharply since Xi Jinping took power in 2012 and began throttling the flow of information in and out of China, building up the Great Firewall to prevent Chinese from viewing many foreign websites. 自习近平于2012年执政并开始收紧跨境信息流动、修筑防火长城以阻断国内民众访问众多外国网站以来，针对 间谍行为的打击 急剧升级。 There are seemingly no limits on what the state can see and hear, and ordinary Chinese have adapted accordingly — most noticeably with regard to the leader himself. 国家的监控范围似乎辽阔无边，普通民众也相应地作出了调适——最明显的莫过于对待最高领导人本人的态度。 北京一条繁华步行街上的摄像头。国家能够看到和听到什么似乎已不受任何限制。 Mr. Xi is everywhere, on television, on billboards and on the front pages of newspapers and websites. But, throughout my stay in China, not one of the hundreds of Chinese I spoke to, mostly in private, ever uttered his name out loud. Even foreigners often avoided it, pointing at the ceiling when they wanted to refer to China’s president. 习近平的身影无处不在，电视上、广告牌上、报纸和网站的头版上都有他。然而，在我停留中国期间私下接触的数百名中国人中，没有一个人敢大声念出他的名字。甚至连外国人也往往避开提及，当想指代中国国家主席时，他们只是用手指指天花板。 The Chinese people whom I met on my travels invariably skirted politics, except when I encountered a zealous patriot during a visit to Dazhai, a former Maoist model commune in a remote mountain area of Shanxi. “Which is better, China or America? Tell the truth!” he shouted, in between praise of China’s leadership and ridicule of the United States and Europe. 我在行程中接触到的中国人无一例外地避谈政治，只有一次例外：在访问山西偏远山区一处 毛泽东时代示范公社 大寨时，我遇到了一位狂热的爱国者。“到底是中国好还是美国好？说实话！”他在赞美中国领导层、嘲弄美欧之余，对我大声嚷嚷道。 Nobody voiced open political dissent but many grumbled about the economy, particularly in places like Hainan Island where a runaway property boom has ground to a halt. A retiree from Shandong who had spent all his savings and borrowed money to buy a Hainan apartment that later lost more than a third of its value told me his much younger wife, his second, was threatening to leave him because he had fallen deeply into debt. 没有人公开发表政治异见，但对经济的不满却比比皆是，尤其是在海南岛这样 狂热的房地产热潮 猝然停滞的地方。一位来自山东的退休老人倾尽毕生积蓄并举债在海南买了一套房子，随后该房产贬值了三分之一以上。他告诉我，他那年轻得多的第二任妻子正以他背负重债为由威胁要与他离婚。 海南岛一片空置的高层建筑群正等待拆除，摄于今年1月。 About the closest anyone came to openly challenging the authorities was in Shanghai when I met an out-of-town party member and his daughter outside a museum celebrating early revolutionaries. 在上海一座纪念早期革命者的博物馆门外，我遇到了一位来自外地的党员和他的女儿。当时发生的大概是我遇到的最接近公开挑战当局的情况了。 Pushed and insulted by police officers when he started to video the entrance, which they said was forbidden, he frothed with anger, cursing them as “hooligans in uniform.” When I asked him what was wrong, he replied, using a Mao-era mantra, that the party and its servants “should serve the people but often forget that.” 当这位党员试图拍摄博物馆入口时，警察称该行为是被禁止的，并对他进行了推搡和斥责。他气得口吐飞沫，咒骂警察是“穿制服的流氓”。当我问他发生了什么时，他借用毛泽东时代的口号回答道，党和官员“本该为人民服务，但他们往往忘了这点”。 His daughter, aware of the surveillance cameras planted on the narrow street, told him to shut up. 他的女儿注意到了狭窄街道上密布的监控摄像头，急忙喝止他不要再说了。 On the 150-yard walk from my Shanghai apartment in a gleaming new tower overlooking Suzhou Creek to the nearest subway, I counted more than 30 cameras trained on pedestrians. There is also a security check at the station, where guards, unfailingly polite, put all passengers’ bags through a scanner. Behind them was a cabinet stuffed with black batons, helmets and other riot control gear. Next to an ad for high-end dog food, a propaganda poster demanded vigilance against unspecified threats. 从我在苏州河畔闪亮的新建高楼里的公寓步行到最近的地铁站，短短一百多米的距离内，我数出了30多个正对着行人的摄像头。地铁站内还设有安检，态度极其礼貌的安检员要求所有乘客将包袋放进扫描仪。在他们身后，摆放着一个塞满黑色警棍、头盔和其他防暴装备的器材柜。一则高端狗粮广告的旁边贴着一张宣传海报，要求警惕未指明的安全威胁。 Vigilance against supposed spies in China has cursed foreign journalists looking for information, no matter how anodyne, for many decades. 对所谓间谍的高度警惕 几十年来一直像咒语一样困扰着试图获取信息的外国记者，哪怕这些信息极其寻常。 When I worked there as a journalist in the 1980s, communism was crumbling next door in the Soviet Union and restlessness over corruption and one-party rule led to huge protests in Tiananmen Square. The party’s account of events after a bloody crackdown routinely accused foreign journalists of spreading “bourgeois liberalism” and stoking “counterrevolutionary turmoil.” Two American reporters were expelled for “obtaining state secrets through illegal means.” 1980年代我担任驻华记者时，邻国苏联的共产主义体制正走向崩溃，对腐败和一党统治的不满引发了天安门广场的大规模抗议。在流血镇压发生后，官方对事件的报道例行公事地指责外国记者传播“资产阶级自由化”并煽动“反革命暴乱”。两名美国记者因“通过非法手段获取国家秘密”而被驱逐出境。 John Burns, the veteran New York Times foreign correspondent, who died in March , was arrested in China in 1986 and charged with espionage after embarking on long motorcycle trip through the hinterland. The charges were later dropped and he was deported. 今年3月去世的《纽约时报》资深战地记者 约翰·伯恩斯曾于1986年在骑行穿越中国腹地时被捕，并被指控犯有间谍罪。这些指控后来被撤销，他随后被驱逐出境。 I was expelled from China in 1991 after obtaining Communist Party internal documents marked top secret and detailing a crackdown on groups accused of fomenting “splittist” sentiment — party code for cultural self-awareness — among ethnic Mongolians in the Chinese region of Inner Mongolia. 我本人则因获取了标记为绝密的中共内部文件于 1991年被驱逐出中国 。这份文件详细记录了针对被控在内蒙古自治区蒙古族人中煽动“分裂主义”情绪——官方对文化自我意识的隐语——的团体进行的镇压。 希金斯走进天安门广场附近北京饭店外的一条地下通道。 Back then, reporters were followed by furtive men who carried satchels fitted with cameras. The watchers are still there, now equipped with cellphone cameras and smart glasses. 在那个时代，跟踪记者的是一些神秘人员，手上拿着内藏相机的挎包。如今，监视者依然存在，只是换上了智能手机摄像头和智能眼镜。 In Dazhai, the former Maoist commune, a photographer and I were followed throughout on foot and by cars crammed with blank-faced men. In Hainan, a man followed us from the street to a sunny beach where we had decided to take a break. Pretending to talk into his cellphone, he kept its camera turned in our direction as we moved around. But the bulk of the surveillance these days is done by A.I.-powered systems that alert security agencies to communication involving people considered potential troublemakers — like foreign journalists. 在那座毛泽东时代的公社大寨，我和一名摄影师全程被步行和乘车的一些面无表情的男子跟踪。在海南，一名男子从街头一直跟踪我们到阳光明媚的沙滩。在我们活动时，他假装在打电话，却始终将摄像头对准我们的方向。不过如今，绝大部分监控工作已交由 人工智能驱动的系统 完成，该系统会自动对涉及外国记者等潜在“麻烦制造者”的通讯发出预警。 WeChat and other apps available in China promise privacy, and most Chinese value the convenience they offer. But the apps are required by cybersecurity and other laws to share user data with the Chinese authorities. This facilitates snooping that, at least to many foreign journalists, smacks of digital dystopia. 微信 及在中国使用的其他应用软件承诺保护隐私，大多数中国人也十分青睐其带来的便利。然而，网络安全法等法律规定，这些应用必须与中国当局共享用户数据。这使得针对个人的监控变得极为便利，在许多外国记者眼中，这种体验充满了数字反乌托邦色彩。 Quickly realizing that any communication over WeChat risked putting old friends in the cross hairs of the security apparatus, I avoided contacting them. But one friend — the daughter of a former senior official, who was on a business trip back to China after years abroad — got in touch. 在迅速意识到通过微信进行的任何联络都可能将老朋友置于安全机构的监视之下后，我选择避免与他们联系。但有一位朋友主动与我取得了联系，她是一名前高级官员的女儿，在海外生活多年后因公回国。 When we met for lunch in Shanghai, we reminisced about the 1980s and friends we had in common, nearly all of whom now live outside China. She raved about “ Blossoms Shanghai ,” a lush, 30-episode television series suffused with nostalgia for China’s roaring ’90s, a period of explosive economic growth and relative openness as the Communist Party relaxed the suffocating grip it imposed after the 1989 Tiananmen massacre. 当我们在上海共进午餐时，我们叙旧回忆起了1980年代和共同的朋友，他们中几乎所有人如今都生活在海外。她对电视剧《 繁花 》赞不绝口。这部30集的精致剧集充满了对中国蓬勃发展的90年代的怀旧情绪，那是一个经济飞速增长、社会相对开放的时期，当时中共放松了在1989年天安门事件后实施的严酷管制。 We entirely avoided the political gossip that used to figure in our conversations. The food was excellent. 我们完全避开了过去谈话中常出现的政治小道消息。午餐的菜肴非常美味。 When I first went to China as a student, I lived in Jinan, an eastern center for state-owned heavy industry that reeked of coal. The city was still recovering from Mao’s Cultural Revolution, a decade of political turmoil that ended in 1976. 当我以学生身份第一次来到中国时 ，住在东部重工业中心济南，那是一座空气中弥漫着煤烟味的城市。当时，这座城市仍处于从1976年结束的十年政治动荡——毛泽东发起的“文化大革命”中复苏的阶段。 The economy was a wreck. Rice, cloth and even matches were in such short supply they could be bought only with ration coupons. The canteen at Shandong University, where I studied, served only greasy gruel with bits of mystery meat and steamed buns. 当时的经济一片凋敝。大米、布匹甚至火柴都极度短缺，只有凭票才能购买。我就读的山东大学食堂只供应油乎乎的粥和馒头，稀饭里漂着几块不知是什么的肉。 山东大学洪家楼校区的大门。1980年至1981年，希金斯曾在这里学习中文。如今，校园被保安严密把守，四处都是监控摄像头。 Time magazine had just named Deng Xiaoping, the supreme leader at the time, its “man of the year,” hailing his “visions of a new China.” 《时代》周刊刚刚将当时的最高领导人邓小平评选为“年度风云人物”，盛赞他对“一个新中国的构想”。 Deng was clear that the party would remain in control, but his path for China’s future was deliberately tentative. It was called “crossing the river by feeling the stones,” an admission of uncertainty that filled my university with excited debate about how to reach the ultimate goal — a China “rich and strong.” 邓小平明确表示党将牢牢掌握控制权，但他为中国未来设计的道路刻意保持着试探性。这被称为“摸着石头过河”，这种对不确定性的坦承，让我的大学校园里充满了关于如何实现“富强”中国这一终极目标的热烈讨论。 Mr. Xi has embraced the same goal but has replaced Deng’s invitation to “feel for stones” with dogmatic certainty. The country is exhorted to show “unswerving loyalty” to Xi Jinping Thought, his blueprint for a “new era” with no room for debate. 习近平继承了这一终极目标，却用教条式的确定性取代了邓小平“摸着石头过河”的倡议。全国上下被要求对习近平思想——他为“新时代”制定的蓝图——表现出“坚定不移的忠诚“，不容置疑。 The campus of Shandong University, open in my student days to the public, is now, like other college grounds in China, sealed off by security guards and studded with surveillance cameras. 在我求学时代，山东大学校园是向社会开放的，如今这里跟中国的其他高校一样，校园被保安严密把守，四处都是监控摄像头。 One of the few buildings near the campus still standing from when I was a student is a huge, German-built Roman Catholic church, which had been converted into a storeroom and workshop. Lavishly renovated since, the church is now again used for religious services, though these are restricted to Christians willing to register and show their passports or ID cards. 校园附近有几座从我学生时代保留至今的建筑，其中包括一座由德国人建造的宏伟天主教堂，当年曾被改作仓库和厂房。后来，这座教堂经过大规模翻修，如今重新用于宗教活动，但只有愿意登记并出示护照或身份证的基督徒才能参加。 济南的天主堂由德国人于一个多世纪前修建，如今重新用于宗教活动，但受到严密监控。 When I first traveled by train to Jinan from Beijing, the journey took all night. It now takes under two hours. Jinan’s main railway station, a grand Art Nouveau building in the center of town built by Germans at the start of the 20th century, has been torn down, replaced by a hyper-modern structure on the outskirts. 我第一次从北京坐火车去济南时，花了整整一夜。现在只需要不到两小时。济南曾经的主要火车站是20世纪初德国人在市中心建造的一座宏伟的新艺术风格建筑，现已被拆除，取而代之的是位于郊区的一座超现代建筑。 I ran into a former classmate whom I remembered as having been something of a maverick. Now a businessman in Shanghai selling private planes, he reminisced about a time when everything was still open to discussion, except the authority of the Communist Party. 我偶遇了一位老同学。记忆中，他曾是个颇为特立独行的人。如今，他在上海经商，销售私人飞机。他怀念那个除了共产党的权威之外一切都还可以公开讨论的年代。 Having to constantly bite one’s tongue, he said, was a modest, if regrettable, price to pay for China’s many other changes for the better. 他说，不得不时时管住自己的嘴，虽然令人遗憾，但与中国在其他许多方面发生的积极变化相比，代价不算大。 In Jinan, I visited the grave of the man I had often sought out as a student for his intimate knowledge of China’s now muffled past. I knew him as “Lao Wen” but his real name was James Veneris, a former American soldier who, after being taken prisoner by Chinese troops during the 1950-53 Korean War, had opted to stay with his captors and been given a job in Jinan. 在济南，我去拜谒了一个熟人的墓 。学生时代，我经常去找他，因为他对中国那段如今已被压抑的历史有着切身的了解。我称他为“老温”，但他的真名是詹姆斯·温纳瑞斯。他曾是一名美国士兵，在1950年至1953年的朝鲜战争期间被中国军队俘虏后，选择留在俘虏他的人身边，后来被安排在济南工作。 Branded an American spy during the Cultural Revolution, he lost his factory job and had been assigned to haul a street cart. His Chinese wife at the time — the second of three — divorced him under duress. 文化大革命期间，他被打成美国间谍，失去了工厂的工作，被派去拉板车。他当时的中国妻子——他三任妻子中的第二任——迫于压力与他离了婚。 When I got to know him in 1980, he had just been rehabilitated. He had a new wife and a new job teaching English at the university. Eager to avoid getting in trouble again, he plastered his campus apartment with portraits of Mao and Hua Guofeng, the new Communist Party chairman after Mao’s death. 当我在1980年认识他时，他刚刚获得平反。他有了新妻子，并在大学里找到了一份教英语的新工作。为了避免再卷入麻烦，他在校园的公寓里贴满了毛泽东和华国锋的画像。华国锋是毛泽东去世后接任的中共中央主席。 He was alarmed when I told him that Hua’s portraits had suddenly disappeared from my lecture hall, a sure sign that he, too, had been purged. 当我告诉他，华国锋像突然从我的教室里消失时，他大为惊恐——这是华国锋也已被清洗的明确信号。 “It’s all so damn confusing,” he groaned. Lao Wen died in Jinan in 2001. “这一切真他妈的让人摸不着头脑，”他叹道。老温于2001年在济南去世。 詹姆斯·温纳瑞斯的墓碑。这名美国士兵在朝鲜战争结束后选择留在中国，2001年在济南去世。 His marble tombstone, paid for by his son, who moved to America, is in a serene new cemetery on the outskirts of Jinan. A gold inscription in English says he had not died, “just disappeared.” A Chinese inscription on the reverse side remembers him as an “American who loved peace, loved life and loved the people of China.” 他的儿子移居美国后，出资为他修建了一块大理石墓碑，墓地位于济南郊外一处宁静的新公墓。墓碑上的金色英文铭文写道，他并未离去，“只是消失了”。背面的中文铭文则称他是一位“热爱和平、热爱生活、热爱中国人民的美国人”。 His many travails are passed over in silence. 至于他生前遭遇的种种磨难，只字未提。 The silence that engulfs so much of China’s past reaches a sinister crescendo in Tiananmen Square, which I had last visited on the night of June 3-4, 1989, when soldiers seized it back from protesting students amid a hail of gunfire. 笼罩着中国诸多过去的沉默 在天安门广场达到了令人胆寒的高潮。我上一次来到这里，是在1989年6月3日深夜至4日清晨，当时军队大肆开枪，从抗议学生手中强行夺回了广场。 By the time I left Beijing in 1991, roads around Tiananmen had all been repaved to remove traces of tank tracks. The square had again become a public space filled with people flying kites and playing with their children. 到1991年我离开北京时，天安门周围的道路都已重新铺设，抹去了坦克履带留下的痕迹。广场重新变回了公共空间，满是放风筝和带着孩子玩耍的民众。 Today, the Chinese capital’s main public square is no longer a place to relax like Red Square in Moscow or Trafalgar Square in London, but a by-appointment-only dead zone. Kites are banned without a permit. All visitors, mostly Chinese from the provinces, are carefully screened. 如今，这座中国首都的核心公共广场不再是像莫斯科红场或伦敦特拉法加广场那样令人放松的去处，而变成了一个仅限预约的死寂之地。未经许可严禁放风筝。所有访客——主要是来自外省的国内游客——都必须接受严格审查。 Before my wife and I could visit in January, we had to apply for permission via WeChat. Once approved, we waited in line for two hours, showing our passports and computer-generated permission notification at three separate checkpoints with airport-style security. 在今年1月前往游览之前，我和妻子必须提前通过微信提交申请。获得批准后，我们在三个配备了机场级安检设施的检查站排队等待了两个小时，出示护照和电子预约通知。 At the final check, a guard pounced on a pen carried by my wife, insisting it contained red ink, which she said was prohibited. She did not say why, but during the 1989 student protests several people hurled red paint at a famous portrait of Mao that faces the square. A security supervisor finally let us through after writing with the pen on a piece of paper and seeing that it was brown, not red. 在最后一道检查关口，一名安检员盯上了我妻子携带的一支笔，坚称笔芯装有红墨水，而红墨水是被禁止带入的。她没有解释原因，但在1989年学生抗议期间，曾有人向面向广场的 那幅著名的毛泽东画像 泼洒红色油漆 。安检主管最终拿这支笔在纸上试写，确认墨水是褐色而非红色后，才放我们通行。 Now out of China, I often wonder: How can it be that a proud, nuclear-armed world power is scared of red ink? 如今离开中国后，我常常感到困惑：一个自豪且拥有核武器的世界大国，究竟为何会害怕一支装有红墨水的笔？ 摄影：Gilles Sabrié Andrew Higgins 是时报东欧和中欧分社社长，常驻华沙。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 俄罗斯疑似鼠疫死亡病例为何令人担忧
description: GIGI KWIK GRONVALL2026年10月12日 Bina Thorsen A 28-year-old woman who worked at an anti-plague research laboratory in Siberia died on Oct. 2, raising concerns and many questions. Russian officials have said that the woman died from a pneumonia of unknown origin and that no “emergency situations” had occurred at the laboratory where she worked. They stated they’d almost finished the investigation of her contacts to monitor for illness, with no concerning findings. 10月2日，一名在西伯利亚一家鼠疫研究实验室工作的28岁女性去世，引发了人们的担忧和诸多疑问。俄罗斯官员表示，这名女性死于病因不明的肺炎，她所在的实验室没有发生任何“紧急事件”。他们还表示，对其接触者进行的健康监测调查已接近尾声，目前没有发现任何令人担忧的情况。 The Russian pronouncements contrasted with furious speculation elsewhere about what happened. Initial, unverified reports from local media suggested that the lab worker had accidentally broken a test tube containing Yersinia pestis, the bacterium that causes the plague. Local hospitals, including a maternity hospital, limited visitors and instituted enhanced health checks. A local factory required masks for its workers. 俄罗斯官方的说法与其他地方对事件真相的激烈猜测形成鲜明对比。当地媒体最初未经证实的报道称，这名实验室工作人员意外打碎了一支装有鼠疫耶尔森菌的试管，这种细菌会引发鼠疫。当地多家医院，包括一家妇产医院，限制了访客，并加强了健康检查。当地一家工厂还要求员工佩戴口罩。 The World Health Organization has said, based on the unofficial information available, that “the public health risk to the general population appears to be low.” Indeed, the available evidence does not point to a global plague emergency. But this tragic death should prompt Americans to question whether we have the capacity to recognize and contain the next disease threat. 世界卫生组织表示，根据现有的非官方信息，“普通公众面临的公共卫生风险似乎较低”。确实，现有证据并不表明全球正面临鼠疫疫情紧急事态。但这起悲剧性的死亡事件应该促使美国人思考：我们是否有能力及时发现并遏制下一场疾病威胁。 While the plague is of course deadly, it is treatable with antibiotics if identified quickly. The form of the plague the Siberian lab worker is rumored to have contracted is called pneumonic plague. It infects the lungs and can spread between people — unlike bubonic plague, the likely cause of the 14th-century Black Death, which is primarily transmitted by flea bites. 鼠疫固然致命，但如果及早确诊，它是可以用抗生素治疗的。据传，这名西伯利亚实验室工作人员感染的是肺鼠疫。肺鼠疫会侵袭肺部，并且可人际传播，这与腺鼠疫不同。腺鼠疫很可能是14世纪黑死病的元凶，主要通过跳蚤叮咬传播。 But even pneumonic plague has relatively limited transmissibility. Historically, one person infected with pneumonic plague has transmitted the disease to an average of 1.3 other people; by way of comparison, measles may transmit to 12 to 18 people in an unvaccinated population. Transmission of the pneumonic plague before symptoms appear has not been documented, so caregivers and close contacts have been the most at risk of infection. Masks, contact tracing and isolation and other established infection control procedures should work well to limit the spread of pneumonic plague. 但即便是肺鼠疫，其传播力也相对有限。历史数据显示，一名肺鼠疫感染者平均会传染1.3个人；相比之下，麻疹在未接种疫苗人群中可能传染12到18人。目前尚无肺鼠疫患者在出现症状前传播疾病的记录，因此，护理人员和密切接触者面临的感染风险最高。佩戴口罩、追踪接触者、实施隔离以及其他既有的感染控制程序应该能够有效限制肺鼠疫的传播。 Still, we should get better answers about what happened in Siberia than those that Russia has so far provided. Was there a laboratory accident? If so, when was it recognized, and what treatment did the exposed lab worker receive? What prompted the extensive monitoring of her contacts? Outsiders’ concerns were in part fueled by speculation about biological weapons. The U.S. intelligence community assesses Russia to have a clandestine biological weapons program. The former Soviet Union included Yersinia pestis, the causative agent of plague, in its armamentarium. 尽管如此，俄罗斯迄今提供的信心远远不够，我们仍有必要弄清西伯利亚究竟发生了什么。实验室是否发生了事故？如果是，事故是在什么时候被发现的？受到暴露的实验室工作人员接受了什么治疗？是什么原因促使当局对她的接触者展开大规模健康监测？外界的担忧在一定程度上受到生物武器相关猜测的推动。美国情报界评估认为，俄罗斯拥有一个秘密生物武器项目。前苏联曾将引发鼠疫的鼠疫耶尔森菌纳入其生物武器库。 Disease surprises could come from many places. That’s why it’s dispiriting that the United States has so isolated itself. After withdrawing from the W.H.O. in January, and calling back the U.S. experts on loan to the organization, America now has less direct information about potential disease emergencies. The dismantling of the United States Agency for International Development cut off scientific collaborations and relationships through which emerging threats could be identified. Cuts and restrictions on infectious disease research have weakened American scientists’ ability to help establish safe laboratory practices internationally. We are diminishing our access to important public health information as well as our influence over what happens next. 疾病带来的意外威胁可能来自许多地方。因此，美国如今如此孤立于国际社会之外令人沮丧。自今年1月退出世界卫生组织并召回借调给该组织的美国专家以来，美国如今能够直接获取的潜在疾病紧急事件信息减少了。美国国际开发署遭解散也切断了原本有助于识别新兴疾病威胁的科研合作及合作关系。对传染病研究的经费削减和限制削弱了美国科学家协助国际社会建立安全实验室操作规范的能力。我们不仅正在减少获取重要公共卫生信息的渠道，也在削弱自身对未来事态发展的影响力。 The Trump administration fired thousands of people at the Department of Health and Human Services, including pandemic experts at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and the Administration for Strategic Preparedness and Response. Losing this expertise has weakened capabilities that took years to build. No quick fix — and no artificial intelligence model — can replace the professional judgment, experience and trusted relationships needed to investigate and assess what is truly going on in a disease outbreak anywhere in the world. Infectious diseases do not recognize borders. 特朗普政府解雇了卫生与公众服务部数千名工作人员，其中包括疾病控制与预防中心以及战略准备与应对管理局的疫情防控专家。这些专业人才的流失削弱了美国耗费多年建立起来的应对能力。要调查和评估世界任何地方暴发的疫情究竟是怎么回事都需要专业判断、丰富经验和长期建立的信任关系。任何权宜之计，乃至任何人工智能模型，都无法取代。传染病不认国界。 During the Covid-19 pandemic, American biotechnology and biological expertise helped deliver vaccines, diagnostics and treatments. The response had profound shortcomings, especially the failure to ramp up diagnostic testing and the lack of personal protective equipment available to medical staff in the earliest days of the pandemic. We should be building on our capacity and correcting those failures. Instead, we are weakening our public health infrastructure while thousands of Americans, including many children, suffer from preventable infections like measles. We are also undermining preparation for future potential threats, such as H5N1 influenza — the bird flu. That virus was recently detected at a U.S. mink farm, and remains a potential pandemic pathogen. The Trump administration canceled a contract to develop an mRNA H5N1 vaccine for humans. 新冠疫情期间，美国的生物技术和生物医学专业能力帮助推动了疫苗、诊断检测手段和治疗方法的开发与应用。但美国的疫情应对存在严重缺陷，尤其是未能迅速扩大诊断检测规模，以及疫情初期医护人员缺乏个人防护装备。我们本应在现有能力的基础上继续加强建设，并纠正这些失误。然而，我们却在削弱公共卫生基础设施，与此同时，包括许多儿童在内的成千上万美国人正遭受麻疹等本可预防的传染病侵袭。我们也在削弱应对未来潜在威胁的准备工作，例如H5N1流感，也就是禽流感。最近，美国一家水貂养殖场检测出了这种病毒，而它仍是一种可能引发大流行的病原体。特朗普政府还取消了一项为人类研发H5N1信使核糖核酸疫苗的合同。 The lesson from an unexplained death in Siberia should be that disease emergencies demand evidence, expertise and cooperation. They demand continued investment in the tools that can be used to investigate and limit disease outbreaks. Most important, they demand investment in the people who can use those tools. 西伯利亚这起死因不明的事件应该带给我们的教训是，应对突发疾病事件需要证据、专业知识和合作。我们必须对疫情的调查及控制工具进行持续投资。最重要的是，我们必须投资于那些能够运用这些工具的专业人才。 图片来源：Chris Ware / Stringer via Getty Images

Initial, unverified reports from local media suggested that the lab worker had accidentally broken a test tube containing Yersinia pestis, the bacterium that causes the plague. Local hospitals, including a maternity hospital, limited visitors and instituted enhanced health checks. A local factory required masks for its workers. 俄罗斯官方的说法与其他地方对事件真相的激烈猜测形成鲜明对比。当地媒体最初未经证实的报道称，这名实验室工作人员意外打碎了一支装有鼠疫耶尔森菌的试管，这种细菌会引发鼠疫。当地多家医院，包括一家妇产医院，限制了访客，并加强了健康检查。当地一家工厂还要求员工佩戴口罩。 The World Health Organization has said , based on the unofficial information available, that “the public health risk to the general population appears to be low.” Indeed, the available evidence does not point to a global plague emergency. But this tragic death should prompt Americans to question whether we have the capacity to recognize and contain the next disease threat. 世界卫生组织 表示 ，根据现有的非官方信息，“普通公众面临的公共卫生风险似乎较低”。确实，现有证据并不表明全球正面临鼠疫疫情紧急事态。但这起悲剧性的死亡事件应该促使美国人思考：我们是否有能力及时发现并遏制下一场疾病威胁。 While the plague is of course deadly, it is treatable with antibiotics if identified quickly. The form of the plague the Siberian lab worker is rumored to have contracted is called pneumonic plague. It infects the lungs and can spread between people — unlike bubonic plague, the likely cause of the 14th-century Black Death, which is primarily transmitted by flea bites. 鼠疫固然致命，但如果及早确诊，它是可以用抗生素治疗的。据传，这名西伯利亚实验室工作人员感染的是肺鼠疫。肺鼠疫会侵袭肺部，并且可人际传播，这与腺鼠疫不同。腺鼠疫很可能是14世纪黑死病的元凶，主要通过跳蚤叮咬传播。 But even pneumonic plague has relatively limited transmissibility. Historically, one person infected with pneumonic plague has transmitted the disease to an average of 1.3 other people; by way of comparison, measles may transmit to 12 to 18 people in an unvaccinated population. Transmission of the pneumonic plague before symptoms appear has not been documented, so caregivers and close contacts have been the most at risk of infection. Masks, contact tracing and isolation and other established infection control procedures should work well to limit the spread of pneumonic plague. 但即便是肺鼠疫，其传播力也相对有限。历史数据显示，一名肺鼠疫感染者平均会传染1.3个人；相比之下，麻疹在未接种疫苗人群中可能传染12到18人。目前尚无肺鼠疫患者在出现症状前传播疾病的记录，因此，护理人员和密切接触者面临的感染风险最高。佩戴口罩、追踪接触者、实施隔离以及其他既有的感染控制程序应该能够有效限制肺鼠疫的传播。 Still, we should get better answers about what happened in Siberia than those that Russia has so far provided. Was there a laboratory accident? If so, when was it recognized, and what treatment did the exposed lab worker receive? What prompted the extensive monitoring of her contacts? Outsiders’ concerns were in part fueled by speculation about biological weapons. The U.S. intelligence community assesses Russia to have a clandestine biological weapons program. The former Soviet Union included Yersinia pestis, the causative agent of plague, in its armamentarium. 尽管如此，俄罗斯迄今提供的信心远远不够，我们仍有必要弄清西伯利亚 究竟发生了什么 。实验室是否发生了事故？如果是，事故是在什么时候被发现的？受到暴露的实验室工作人员接受了什么治疗？是什么原因促使当局对她的接触者展开大规模健康监测？外界的担忧在一定程度上受到生物武器相关猜测的推动。美国情报界 评估 认为，俄罗斯拥有一个秘密生物武器项目。前苏联曾将引发鼠疫的鼠疫耶尔森菌纳入其生物武器库。 Disease surprises could come from many places. That’s why it’s dispiriting that the United States has so isolated itself. After withdrawing from the W.H.O. in January, and calling back the U.S. experts on loan to the organization, America now has less direct information about potential disease emergencies. The dismantling of the United States Agency for International Development cut off scientific collaborations and relationships through which emerging threats could be identified. Cuts and restrictions on infectious disease research have weakened American scientists’ ability to help establish safe laboratory practices internationally. We are diminishing our access to important public health information as well as our influence over what happens next. 疾病带来的意外威胁可能来自许多地方。因此，美国如今如此孤立于国际社会之外令人沮丧。自今年1月退出世界卫生组织并 召回 借调给该组织的美国专家以来，美国如今能够直接获取的潜在疾病紧急事件信息减少了。美国国际开发署遭 解散 也切断了原本有助于识别新兴疾病威胁的科研合作及合作关系。对传染病研究的经费削减和限制削弱了美国科学家协助国际社会建立安全实验室操作规范的能力。我们不仅正在减少获取重要公共卫生信息的渠道，也在削弱自身对未来事态发展的影响力。 The Trump administration fired thousands of people at the Department of Health and Human Services, including pandemic experts at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and the Administration for Strategic Preparedness and Response. Losing this expertise has weakened capabilities that took years to build. No quick fix — and no artificial intelligence model — can replace the professional judgment, experience and trusted relationships needed to investigate and assess what is truly going on in a disease outbreak anywhere in the world. Infectious diseases do not recognize borders. 特朗普政府解雇了卫生与公众服务部数千名工作人员，其中包括疾病控制与预防中心以及战略准备与应对管理局的疫情防控专家。这些专业人才的流失削弱了美国耗费多年建立起来的应对能力。要调查和评估世界任何地方暴发的疫情究竟是怎么回事都需要专业判断、丰富经验和长期建立的信任关系。任何权宜之计，乃至任何人工智能模型，都无法取代。传染病不认国界。 During the Covid-19 pandemic, American biotechnology and biological expertise helped deliver vaccines, diagnostics and treatments. The response had profound shortcomings, especially the failure to ramp up diagnostic testing and the lack of personal protective equipment available to medical staff in the earliest days of the pandemic. We should be building on our capacity and correcting those failures. Instead, we are weakening our public health infrastructure while thousands of Americans, including many children, suffer from preventable infections like measles. We are also undermining preparation for future potential threats, such as H5N1 influenza — the bird flu. That virus was recently detected at a U.S. mink farm , and remains a potential pandemic pathogen. The Trump administration canceled a contract to develop an mRNA H5N1 vaccine for humans. 新冠疫情期间，美国的生物技术和生物医学专业能力帮助推动了疫苗、诊断检测手段和治疗方法的开发与应用。但美国的疫情应对存在严重缺陷，尤其是未能迅速扩大诊断检测规模，以及疫情初期医护人员缺乏个人防护装备。我们本应在现有能力的基础上继续加强建设，并纠正这些失误。然而，我们却在削弱公共卫生基础设施，与此同时，包括许多儿童在内的成千上万美国人正遭受麻疹等本可预防的传染病侵袭。我们也在削弱应对未来潜在威胁的准备工作，例如H5N1流感，也就是禽流感。最近，美国一家 水貂养殖场 检测出了这种病毒，而它仍是一种可能引发大流行的病原体。特朗普政府还 取消 了一项为人类研发H5N1信使核糖核酸疫苗的合同。 The lesson from an unexplained death in Siberia should be that disease emergencies demand evidence, expertise and cooperation. They demand continued investment in the tools that can be used to investigate and limit disease outbreaks. Most important, they demand investment in the people who can use those tools. 西伯利亚这起死因不明的事件应该带给我们的教训是，应对突发疾病事件需要证据、专业知识和合作。我们必须对疫情的调查及控制工具进行持续投资。最重要的是，我们必须投资于那些能够运用这些工具的专业人才。 图片来源：Chris Ware / Stringer via Getty Images

title: 一家中国小银行如何帮助俄罗斯规避制裁进入华尔街
description: AARON KROLIK2026年10月12日中国的地区性银行浙江稠州商业银行在吉尔吉斯斯坦、蒙古、哈萨克斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦拥有大量业务，这些国家与俄罗斯有密切的经济联系。 Costfoto/NurPhoto, via Getty Images The Bank of America account ending in 0252 was not what you might expect. 这个尾号为0252的美国银行账户并非你想象的那样。 It did not belong to a person or a business. In fact, the money did not belong to any single entity. 它不属于某个人或某家企业。事实上，账户里的钱不属于任何单一实体。 The account had funds pooled from countless customers of Zhejiang Chouzhou Commercial Bank, a regional lender in the eastern Chinese city of Yiwu. 账户汇集了众多浙江稠州商业银行客户的钱款。这家地区性银行位于中国东部城市义乌。 And among Chouzhou Bank’s customers were Russian front companies that had burrowed into the global financial system as part of a sprawling effort to evade Western sanctions, a New York Times analysis of thousands of financial documents and bank transactions found. 《纽约时报》对数千份金融文件和银行交易的分析发现，稠州商业银行的客户包括俄罗斯的幌子公司。它们作为规避西方制裁的庞大行动的一部分，已潜入全球金融体系。 Chouzhou Bank provides what are known as correspondent services, a common banking practice that allows local banks to offer international services across many currencies to customers without opening branches abroad. 稠行提供所谓的代理行服务。这是一种常见的银行业务，允许本地银行无需在海外开设分行，就能为客户提供多种货币的国际服务。 Chouzhou is one of many institutions that have found a lucrative business as middlemen in places where Western banks are reluctant to serve. Often, smaller banks hire banks like Chouzhou that have correspondent accounts at big Wall Street firms, creating a nesting doll effect in the financial system that can mask illicit activity. 在西方银行不愿服务的地区，许多机构充当中间人，找到了有利可图的业务，稠行便是其中之一。通常，较小的银行会聘用像稠行这样在华尔街大公司拥有代理账户的银行，从而在金融系统中形成一种套娃效应，可以掩盖非法活动。 Since the invasion of Ukraine four years ago, finding and exploiting weak links in the correspondent system has become an important part of Russia’s effort to sidestep U.S. economic restrictions, the Times analysis shows. 时报分析显示，自四年前入侵乌克兰以来，寻找并利用代理行系统中的薄弱环节已成为俄罗斯规避美国经济限制努力的重要组成部分。 In addition to legitimate clients, more than 50 companies that sold restricted electronics, industrial chemicals, and other goods and services to Russia in the first four months of 2025 held accounts at Chouzhou. 除了合法客户外，2025年前四个月向俄罗斯出售受限电子产品、工业化学品及其他商品和服务的50多家公司也在稠行持有账户。 Many of the documents reviewed by The Times were generated by A7, a Moscow-based financial services firm. A trove of its records from early 2025 was posted online by hackers. In addition, The Times obtained and analyzed thousands of business transactions and other documents from internal databases that the firm had left unsecured online. Chouzhou Bank appeared repeatedly throughout the documents, providing a detailed example of the role that correspondent services play in sanctions evasion. 时报审阅的许多文件来自总部位于莫斯科的金融服务公司A7。黑客在网上发布了该公司2025年初的大量记录。此外，时报还获取并分析了数千笔商业交易和其他文件，这些来自该公司在网上未受保护的内部数据库。稠行在文件中反复出现，为代理行服务在制裁规避中所起的作用提供了一个详细例证。 A7 did not respond to a request for comment. The Times reported last month that A7 helps Russian businesses evade economic restrictions by sending money abroad to buy goods, often through shell companies that have little purpose other than to mask such purchases. A7未回应置评请求。时报上个月报道，A7通过将资金汇往国外购买商品，帮助俄罗斯企业规避经济限制，通常是通过除了掩盖此类采购外别无其他目的的空壳公司。 One shell company working on behalf of A7 in Kyrgyzstan made more than $10 million of restricted purchases during that period through a bank that held an account at Chouzhou. 通过一家在稠行持有账户的银行，一家在吉尔吉斯斯坦代表A7工作的空壳公司在此期间进行了超过1000万美元的受限采购。 In other instances, Russian companies bought industrial goods, including precision grinding machines that could be used to manufacturer components for weapons. 还有一些俄罗斯公司购买了工业产品，包括可用于制造武器部件的精密磨床。 In January 2025, transaction documents show, a Russian company bought $73,000 of components used to build electronic warfare systems. The parts were supplied by a Hong Kong distributor with a history of sales to Russian buyers, according to trade data. 交易文件显示，2025年1月，一家俄罗斯公司购买了价值7.3万美元的组件，用于制造电子战系统。贸易数据显示，这些部件由一家有向俄罗斯买家销售历史的香港分销商供应。 To complete the sale, First Abu Dhabi Bank, an Emirati bank, arranged to have the money sent to Chouzhou’s account at Bank of America. 为完成这笔交易，阿联酋的第一阿布扎比银行安排将资金汇至稠行在美国银行的账户。 As is standard practice in correspondent transactions, Bank of America received money transfer orders, but not details about the purchase itself. That allowed the nature of the goods, and who was buying them, to be obscured as the sale worked its way through the international banking system. 按照代理行交易的标准做法，美国银行收到了汇款指令，但不会得到有关采购本身的细节。这使得货物的性质以及买家的身份在交易通过国际银行系统进行时得以被掩盖。 Without explanation in June 2025, Bank of America ended its relationship with Chouzhou Bank, closing Account 0252, whose existence was disclosed on a Kyrgyz bank website. Chouzhou has continued to provide access to the dollar — through Citibank, JPMorgan Chase and Standard Chartered — for dozens of banks that otherwise lack direct access to the U.S. financial system, including in countries that have close economic ties to Russia, The Times found. 2025年6月，美国银行在没有解释的情况下终止了与稠行的关系，关闭了0252账户。该账户的存在曾在一家吉尔吉斯斯坦银行网站上披露。时报发现，稠行继续通过花旗银行、摩根大通和渣打银行为数十家原本无法直接进入美国金融系统的银行提供美元通道，其中包括与俄罗斯有密切经济联系的国家。 Chouzhou did not respond to detailed requests for comment. Reached in person at a banking conference in Miami in late September, a manager for the bank’s correspondent banking division declined to comment. 稠行未回应详细的置评请求。9月下旬在迈阿密举行的一次银行业会议上，本报得以面见该行代理行部门的一位经理，对方拒绝置评。 Representatives from Bank of America, Citigroup, Standard Chartered and First Abu Dhabi all said that they worked closely with law enforcement officials and governments. The representatives added that their banks regularly monitored correspondent activity and reported suspicious activity to the authorities in order to identify and help disrupt illicit banking networks. 美国银行、花旗集团、渣打银行和第一阿布扎比银行的代表均表示，他们与执法官员和政府密切合作。这些代表补充说，他们的银行定期监控代理行活动，并向当局报告可疑活动，以识别并帮助破坏非法银行网络。 While a spokeswoman for Citi and a spokesman for First Abu Dhabi said they would not comment on specific customers, all four banks emphasized that they maintained rigorous internal controls to combat money laundering, sanctions evasion and other financial crimes. JPMorgan declined to comment. 尽管花旗和第一阿布扎比的发言人都表示不会对特定客户置评，但四家银行均强调，他们保持着严格的内部控制，以打击洗钱、制裁规避和其他金融犯罪。摩根大通拒绝置评。 An essential piece of plumbing 必不可少的基础设施 The correspondent banking system is an opaque and antiquated yet essential piece of financial plumbing that underpins international finance. It has played a crucial role in making the dollar the dominant currency for international trade and giving the United States unmatched leverage over financial transactions. 作为国际金融的支柱，代理行系统是一个不透明且陈旧但又必不可少的金融管道。它在使美元成为国际贸易主导货币以及赋予美国在金融交易中无可比拟的影响力方面发挥了至关重要的作用。 Here’s how it works: Imagine that a fabric exporter in rural China wants to sell its goods to customers abroad. It would be impractical for the exporter, or even its local bank, to maintain accounts in every country and in every currency that its customers might want to use. 其运作方式如下：想象一下，中国农村的一家面料出口商想向海外客户出售商品。对于该出口商，甚至其当地银行来说，在客户可能想要使用的每个国家和每种货币中维护账户是不切实际的。 Correspondent banking solves this problem. The exporter’s local Chinese bank holds dollar, euro and other currency accounts at a select few global banks. Through those accounts, the Chinese bank gains access to the broad networks of those international banks, allowing its customers to send and receive international payments and convert proceeds into local currencies. 代理行解决了这个问题。出口商的当地中资银行在少数全球银行持有美元、欧元和其他货币账户。通过这些账户，中资银行获得了这些国际银行的广泛网络，使其客户能够收发国际支付，并将收益兑换成本地货币。 By its nature, however, the correspondent system can add distance between big banks and small companies seeking to circumvent their controls. Big banks often delegate the vetting of customers and transactions to smaller banks further down the correspondent chain. 然而，代理行系统本质上会在大银行与试图规避其控制的小公司之间增加距离。大银行通常将客户和交易的审查委托给代理链下游的小银行。 When new regulations were put in place to stop terror financing after the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, banks began cutting correspondent relationships around the globe. 2001年9月11日袭击后为阻断恐怖主义资金渠道而实施了新规，银行随即开始在全球范围内削减代理行关系。 Sudan, which the United States labeled a state sponsor of terrorism, was hit especially hard. Many banks stopped handling payments from the country, raising fears that it could be cut off from the global financial system and pushed toward shadow banking networks in order to supply its citizens with even basic necessities. 被美国列为支持恐怖主义国家的苏丹受到的打击尤其严重。许多银行停止处理来自该国的付款，引发其被隔绝于全球金融体系之外的担忧，哪怕国民的最基本需求都被迫要转向影子银行网络。 Since then, regulators have tried to balance the risk of sanctions evasion with the goal of keeping the dollar used around the world. In 2016, the Treasury Department issued guidance that said banks did not need to individually vet their correspondent’s clients, a practice called “know your customer’s customer.” 自那以后，监管机构一直试图在制裁规避风险与保持美元在全球使用这一目标之间取得平衡。2016年，美国财政部发布指引称，银行无需逐一审查其代理行客户——也就是所谓“了解你的客户的客户”的原则。 When transactions pass through an American bank, the Treasury Department has broad jurisdiction to regulate and police the activity. Last month, for example, the U.S. government issued economic restrictions against two foreign banks that used the correspondent system to help Iran gain access to the dollar system in order to launder money and evade sanctions on behalf of the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps. 当交易通过美国银行时，美国财政部拥有广泛的管辖权来监管和监督该活动。例如，上个月，美国政府对外国银行实施经济限制，这两家银行利用代理行系统帮助伊朗进入美元体系，以便为伊斯兰革命卫队洗钱和规避制裁。 U.S. banks can face legal liability for processing restricted transactions even when acting only as a correspondent for another financial institution. However, the Treasury Department has discretion over the cases it pursues. 即使仅作为另一家金融机构的代理行处理受限交易，美国银行也可能面临法律责任。然而，美国财政部对追查哪些案件拥有自由裁量权。 Depending on the extent of the illicit activity and the level of the bank’s due diligence, it would be difficult to imagine an American bank being penalized for unwittingly playing a role in a sophisticated sanctions evasion scheme, according to a former senior Treasury official who was not authorized to speak publicly about enforcement procedures. 据一位未获授权公开谈论执法程序的前财政部高级官员称，很难想象一家美国银行会因在复杂的制裁规避计划中无意中发挥作用而受到处罚，具体要看非法活动的情节和银行尽职调查的水平。 A critical lifeline 一条关键的生命线 Chouzhou was founded in Yiwu in 1987 and grew as the midsize Chinese trading city blossomed into a manufacturing hub for goods that are sent around the world. 稠州商业银行于1987年在义乌成立，随着这座中国中型贸易城市发展成为向世界各地输送商品的制造业中心而成长。 Over the years, it carved out a niche by offering correspondent services to dozens of banks in countries identified by Western officials as high risk for money laundering or sanctions evasion, including Afghanistan, Yemen and South Sudan, according to the documents obtained by The Times and data from BankCheck, a correspondent banking compliance platform. 据时报获得的文件以及代理行合规平台BankCheck的数据，多年来，通过向西方官员认定为洗钱或制裁规避高风险的数十个国家的银行提供代理行服务，这家银行开辟了一个利基市场，这些国家包括阿富汗、也门和南苏丹。 Chouzhou has an especially large presence in Kyrgyzstan, Georgia and Uzbekistan — countries with close economic ties to Russia that have become important hubs for rerouted trade. 稠行在吉尔吉斯斯坦、格鲁吉亚和乌兹别克斯坦尤其活跃，这些国家与俄罗斯有密切经济联系，已成为改道贸易的重要枢纽。 According to the BankCheck data, Chouzhou provides access to dollar accounts to nearly 70 other banks, most of which otherwise lack direct access to the U.S. financial system. Those banks, in turn, market dollar accounts to their customers. 根据BankCheck数据，稠行为近70家其他银行提供美元账户通道，其中大多数原本无法直接进入美国金融系统。这些银行反过来又向客户推销美元账户。 By comparison, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, the largest bank in the world by assets, provides dollar access to 20 banks. HSBC Bank in London provides just seven dollar correspondent accounts to other banks, BankCheck data shows. 相比之下，按资产计全球最大的银行中国工商银行为20家银行提供美元通道。BankCheck数据显示，伦敦的汇丰银行仅向其他银行提供七个美元代理账户。 In 2024, Chouzhou processed more than $200 billion in international transactions, according to a bond prospectus, nearly four times the amount of its total assets. But that is likely a small fraction of its activity now: At the financial services conference in Miami last month, Chouzhou advertised relationships with more than 1,000 banks and the ability to process payments in 27 currencies. 根据一份债券招股说明书，2024年，稠行处理了超过2000亿美元的国际交易，将近其总资产的四倍。但这可能只是其当前活动的一小部分：在上个月迈阿密的金融服务会议上，稠行宣传其与1000多家银行保持着关系，有能力处理27种货币支付。 Chouzhou stopped processing transactions directly with Russian and Belarusian banks in early 2024, according to news releases and trade documents. But it has continued working with customers and banks in countries considered high risk for Russian sanctions evasion. 据新闻稿和贸易文件，稠行于2024年初停止直接处理与俄罗斯和白俄罗斯银行的交易。但它继续与被视为俄罗斯制裁规避高风险国家的客户和银行合作。 Soon after Bank of America ended its relationship with Chouzhou last year, the Chinese bank opened two new dollar accounts at Citibank and Standard Chartered, BankCheck data shows. BankCheck数据显示，去年美国银行终止与稠行的关系后不久，这家中国银行在花旗银行和渣打银行开设了两个新的美元账户。 The accounts remain open. 这些账户至今仍正常使用。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site
content: AARON KROLIK 2026年10月12日 中国的地区性银行浙江稠州商业银行在吉尔吉斯斯坦、蒙古、哈萨克斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦拥有大量业务，这些国家与俄罗斯有密切的经济联系。 Costfoto/NurPhoto, via Getty Images The Bank of America account ending in 0252 was not what you might expect. 这个尾号为0252的美国银行账户并非你想象的那样。 It did not belong to a person or a business. In fact, the money did not belong to any single entity. 它不属于某个人或某家企业。事实上，账户里的钱不属于任何单一实体。 The account had funds pooled from countless customers of Zhejiang Chouzhou Commercial Bank, a regional lender in the eastern Chinese city of Yiwu. 账户汇集了众多浙江稠州商业银行客户的钱款。这家地区性银行位于中国东部城市义乌。 And among Chouzhou Bank’s customers were Russian front companies that had burrowed into the global financial system as part of a sprawling effort to evade Western sanctions, a New York Times analysis of thousands of financial documents and bank transactions found. 《纽约时报》对数千份金融文件和银行交易的分析发现，稠州商业银行的客户包括俄罗斯的幌子公司。它们作为规避西方制裁的庞大行动的一部分，已潜入全球金融体系。 Chouzhou Bank provides what are known as correspondent services, a common banking practice that allows local banks to offer international services across many currencies to customers without opening branches abroad. 稠行提供所谓的代理行服务。这是一种常见的银行业务，允许本地银行无需在海外开设分行，就能为客户提供多种货币的国际服务。 Chouzhou is one of many institutions that have found a lucrative business as middlemen in places where Western banks are reluctant to serve. Often, smaller banks hire banks like Chouzhou that have correspondent accounts at big Wall Street firms, creating a nesting doll effect in the financial system that can mask illicit activity. 在西方银行不愿服务的地区，许多机构充当中间人，找到了有利可图的业务，稠行便是其中之一。通常，较小的银行会聘用像稠行这样在华尔街大公司拥有代理账户的银行，从而在金融系统中形成一种套娃效应，可以掩盖非法活动。 Since the invasion of Ukraine four years ago, finding and exploiting weak links in the correspondent system has become an important part of Russia’s effort to sidestep U.S. economic restrictions, the Times analysis shows. 时报分析显示，自四年前入侵乌克兰以来，寻找并利用代理行系统中的薄弱环节已成为俄罗斯规避美国经济限制努力的重要组成部分。 In addition to legitimate clients, more than 50 companies that sold restricted electronics, industrial chemicals, and other goods and services to Russia in the first four months of 2025 held accounts at Chouzhou. 除了合法客户外，2025年前四个月向俄罗斯出售受限电子产品、工业化学品及其他商品和服务的50多家公司也在稠行持有账户。 Many of the documents reviewed by The Times were generated by A7 , a Moscow-based financial services firm. A trove of its records from early 2025 was posted online by hackers. In addition, The Times obtained and analyzed thousands of business transactions and other documents from internal databases that the firm had left unsecured online. Chouzhou Bank appeared repeatedly throughout the documents, providing a detailed example of the role that correspondent services play in sanctions evasion. 时报审阅的许多文件来自总部位于莫斯科的金融服务公司 A7 。黑客在网上发布了该公司2025年初的大量记录。此外，时报还获取并分析了数千笔商业交易和其他文件，这些来自该公司在网上未受保护的内部数据库。稠行在文件中反复出现，为代理行服务在制裁规避中所起的作用提供了一个详细例证。 A7 did not respond to a request for comment. The Times reported last month that A7 helps Russian businesses evade economic restrictions by sending money abroad to buy goods, often through shell companies that have little purpose other than to mask such purchases. A7未回应置评请求。 时报上个月报道 ，A7通过将资金汇往国外购买商品，帮助俄罗斯企业规避经济限制，通常是通过除了掩盖此类采购外别无其他目的的空壳公司。 One shell company working on behalf of A7 in Kyrgyzstan made more than $10 million of restricted purchases during that period through a bank that held an account at Chouzhou. 通过一家在稠行持有账户的银行，一家在吉尔吉斯斯坦代表A7工作的空壳公司在此期间进行了超过1000万美元的受限采购。 In other instances, Russian companies bought industrial goods, including precision grinding machines that could be used to manufacturer components for weapons. 还有一些俄罗斯公司购买了工业产品，包括可用于制造武器部件的精密磨床。 In January 2025, transaction documents show, a Russian company bought $73,000 of components used to build electronic warfare systems. The parts were supplied by a Hong Kong distributor with a history of sales to Russian buyers, according to trade data. 交易文件显示，2025年1月，一家俄罗斯公司购买了价值7.3万美元的组件，用于制造电子战系统。贸易数据显示，这些部件由一家有向俄罗斯买家销售历史的香港分销商供应。 To complete the sale, First Abu Dhabi Bank, an Emirati bank, arranged to have the money sent to Chouzhou’s account at Bank of America. 为完成这笔交易，阿联酋的第一阿布扎比银行安排将资金汇至稠行在美国银行的账户。 As is standard practice in correspondent transactions, Bank of America received money transfer orders, but not details about the purchase itself. That allowed the nature of the goods, and who was buying them, to be obscured as the sale worked its way through the international banking system. 按照代理行交易的标准做法，美国银行收到了汇款指令，但不会得到有关采购本身的细节。这使得货物的性质以及买家的身份在交易通过国际银行系统进行时得以被掩盖。 Without explanation in June 2025, Bank of America ended its relationship with Chouzhou Bank, closing Account 0252, whose existence was disclosed on a Kyrgyz bank website. Chouzhou has continued to provide access to the dollar — through Citibank, JPMorgan Chase and Standard Chartered — for dozens of banks that otherwise lack direct access to the U.S. financial system, including in countries that have close economic ties to Russia, The Times found. 2025年6月，美国银行在没有解释的情况下终止了与稠行的关系，关闭了0252账户。该账户的存在曾在一家吉尔吉斯斯坦银行网站上披露。时报发现，稠行继续通过花旗银行、摩根大通和渣打银行为数十家原本无法直接进入美国金融系统的银行提供美元通道，其中包括与俄罗斯有密切经济联系的国家。 Chouzhou did not respond to detailed requests for comment. Reached in person at a banking conference in Miami in late September, a manager for the bank’s correspondent banking division declined to comment. 稠行未回应详细的置评请求。9月下旬在迈阿密举行的一次银行业会议上，本报得以面见该行代理行部门的一位经理，对方拒绝置评。 Representatives from Bank of America, Citigroup, Standard Chartered and First Abu Dhabi all said that they worked closely with law enforcement officials and governments. The representatives added that their banks regularly monitored correspondent activity and reported suspicious activity to the authorities in order to identify and help disrupt illicit banking networks. 美国银行、花旗集团、渣打银行和第一阿布扎比银行的代表均表示，他们与执法官员和政府密切合作。这些代表补充说，他们的银行定期监控代理行活动，并向当局报告可疑活动，以识别并帮助破坏非法银行网络。 While a spokeswoman for Citi and a spokesman for First Abu Dhabi said they would not comment on specific customers, all four banks emphasized that they maintained rigorous internal controls to combat money laundering, sanctions evasion and other financial crimes. JPMorgan declined to comment. 尽管花旗和第一阿布扎比的发言人都表示不会对特定客户置评，但四家银行均强调，他们保持着严格的内部控制，以打击洗钱、制裁规避和其他金融犯罪。摩根大通拒绝置评。 An essential piece of plumbing 必不可少的基础设施 The correspondent banking system is an opaque and antiquated yet essential piece of financial plumbing that underpins international finance. It has played a crucial role in making the dollar the dominant currency for international trade and giving the United States unmatched leverage over financial transactions. 作为国际金融的支柱，代理行系统是一个不透明且陈旧但又必不可少的金融管道。它在使美元成为国际贸易主导货币以及赋予美国在金融交易中无可比拟的影响力方面发挥了至关重要的作用。 Here’s how it works: Imagine that a fabric exporter in rural China wants to sell its goods to customers abroad. It would be impractical for the exporter, or even its local bank, to maintain accounts in every country and in every currency that its customers might want to use. 其运作方式如下：想象一下，中国农村的一家面料出口商想向海外客户出售商品。对于该出口商，甚至其当地银行来说，在客户可能想要使用的每个国家和每种货币中维护账户是不切实际的。 Correspondent banking solves this problem. The exporter’s local Chinese bank holds dollar, euro and other currency accounts at a select few global banks. Through those accounts, the Chinese bank gains access to the broad networks of those international banks, allowing its customers to send and receive international payments and convert proceeds into local currencies. 代理行解决了这个问题。出口商的当地中资银行在少数全球银行持有美元、欧元和其他货币账户。通过这些账户，中资银行获得了这些国际银行的广泛网络，使其客户能够收发国际支付，并将收益兑换成本地货币。 By its nature, however, the correspondent system can add distance between big banks and small companies seeking to circumvent their controls. Big banks often delegate the vetting of customers and transactions to smaller banks further down the correspondent chain. 然而，代理行系统本质上会在大银行与试图规避其控制的小公司之间增加距离。大银行通常将客户和交易的审查委托给代理链下游的小银行。 When new regulations were put in place to stop terror financing after the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks, banks began cutting correspondent relationships around the globe. 2001年9月11日袭击后为阻断恐怖主义资金渠道而实施了新规，银行随即开始在全球范围内削减代理行关系。 Sudan, which the United States labeled a state sponsor of terrorism, was hit especially hard. Many banks stopped handling payments from the country, raising fears that it could be cut off from the global financial system and pushed toward shadow banking networks in order to supply its citizens with even basic necessities. 被美国列为支持恐怖主义国家的苏丹受到的打击尤其严重。许多银行停止处理来自该国的付款，引发其被隔绝于全球金融体系之外的担忧，哪怕国民的最基本需求都被迫要转向影子银行网络。 Since then, regulators have tried to balance the risk of sanctions evasion with the goal of keeping the dollar used around the world. In 2016, the Treasury Department issued guidance that said banks did not need to individually vet their correspondent’s clients, a practice called “know your customer’s customer.” 自那以后，监管机构一直试图在制裁规避风险与保持美元在全球使用这一目标之间取得平衡。2016年，美国财政部发布指引称，银行无需逐一审查其代理行客户——也就是所谓“了解你的客户的客户”的原则。 When transactions pass through an American bank, the Treasury Department has broad jurisdiction to regulate and police the activity. Last month, for example, the U.S. government issued economic restrictions against two foreign banks that used the correspondent system to help Iran gain access to the dollar system in order to launder money and evade sanctions on behalf of the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps. 当交易通过美国银行时，美国财政部拥有广泛的管辖权来监管和监督该活动。例如，上个月，美国政府对外国银行实施经济限制，这两家银行利用代理行系统帮助伊朗进入美元体系，以便为伊斯兰革命卫队洗钱和规避制裁。 U.S. banks can face legal liability for processing restricted transactions even when acting only as a correspondent for another financial institution. However, the Treasury Department has discretion over the cases it pursues. 即使仅作为另一家金融机构的代理行处理受限交易，美国银行也可能面临法律责任。然而，美国财政部对追查哪些案件拥有自由裁量权。 Depending on the extent of the illicit activity and the level of the bank’s due diligence, it would be difficult to imagine an American bank being penalized for unwittingly playing a role in a sophisticated sanctions evasion scheme, according to a former senior Treasury official who was not authorized to speak publicly about enforcement procedures. 据一位未获授权公开谈论执法程序的前财政部高级官员称，很难想象一家美国银行会因在复杂的制裁规避计划中无意中发挥作用而受到处罚，具体要看非法活动的情节和银行尽职调查的水平。 A critical lifeline 一条关键的生命线 Chouzhou was founded in Yiwu in 1987 and grew as the midsize Chinese trading city blossomed into a manufacturing hub for goods that are sent around the world. 稠州商业银行于1987年在义乌成立，随着这座中国中型贸易城市发展成为向世界各地输送商品的制造业中心而成长。 Over the years, it carved out a niche by offering correspondent services to dozens of banks in countries identified by Western officials as high risk for money laundering or sanctions evasion, including Afghanistan, Yemen and South Sudan, according to the documents obtained by The Times and data from BankCheck, a correspondent banking compliance platform. 据时报获得的文件以及代理行合规平台BankCheck的数据，多年来，通过向西方官员认定为洗钱或制裁规避高风险的数十个国家的银行提供代理行服务，这家银行开辟了一个利基市场，这些国家包括阿富汗、也门和南苏丹。 Chouzhou has an especially large presence in Kyrgyzstan, Georgia and Uzbekistan — countries with close economic ties to Russia that have become important hubs for rerouted trade. 稠行在吉尔吉斯斯坦、格鲁吉亚和乌兹别克斯坦尤其活跃，这些国家与俄罗斯有密切经济联系，已成为改道贸易的重要枢纽。 According to the BankCheck data, Chouzhou provides access to dollar accounts to nearly 70 other banks, most of which otherwise lack direct access to the U.S. financial system. Those banks, in turn, market dollar accounts to their customers. 根据BankCheck数据，稠行为近70家其他银行提供美元账户通道，其中大多数原本无法直接进入美国金融系统。这些银行反过来又向客户推销美元账户。 By comparison, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, the largest bank in the world by assets, provides dollar access to 20 banks. HSBC Bank in London provides just seven dollar correspondent accounts to other banks, BankCheck data shows. 相比之下，按资产计全球最大的银行中国工商银行为20家银行提供美元通道。BankCheck数据显示，伦敦的汇丰银行仅向其他银行提供七个美元代理账户。 In 2024, Chouzhou processed more than $200 billion in international transactions, according to a bond prospectus, nearly four times the amount of its total assets. title: 鼠疫疑云超一周，俄罗斯仍未作出官方解释
description: PAUL SONNE, JULIAN E. BARNES2026年10月12日位于俄罗斯伊尔库茨克的西伯利亚及远东地区抗鼠疫研究所，摄于周三。该所一名28岁研究人员死于不明原因的肺炎。” Associated Press More than a week after a young plague researcher’s mysterious death from pneumonia, Russia has still not publicly identified the pathogen that killed her. 一名年轻的鼠疫研究人员因肺炎神秘死亡已超过一周，俄罗斯至今仍未公开确认导致她死亡的病原体。 The possibility that the researcher contracted pneumonic plague in her lab led to global fears of an outbreak. Those worries have begun to recede as no other known cases have surfaced in the Irkutsk region, where Darya Shipilova, a 28-year-old researcher at the Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East, died on Oct. 2. 由于这名研究人员可能是在实验室感染肺鼠疫的，这引发了全球对疫情暴发的担忧。不过，随着伊尔库茨克地区未出现其他已知病例，这种担忧已经开始消退。10月2日，28岁的达里娅·希皮洛娃在该地区去世。她生前是西伯利亚及远东地区抗鼠疫研究所的一名研究人员。 But the absence of an official explanation for Ms. Shipilova’s death, despite thousands of tests conducted on others in the community and on her own remains, has stoked concerns about what, if anything, Russia’s authoritarian government might be hiding. 然而，尽管当局对当地其他居民以及希皮洛娃的遗体进行了数千次检测，却始终未对她的死因给出官方解释，这不禁令人怀疑，俄罗斯威权政府是否有所隐瞒，如果确实如此，它究竟在隐瞒什么？ According to Rospotrebnadzor, the Russian public health regulator, Ms. Shipilova’s remains did not test positive for any of the dangerous pathogens she was working on at the institute, which included the bacterium that causes the plague. The regulator has said she died of pneumonia of an unknown origin. Pneumonia can be caused by numerous viruses, bacteria and fungi. 据俄罗斯公共卫生监管机构——联邦消费者权益保护和公益监督局称，希皮洛娃的遗体没有检测出她在研究所接触的任何危险病原体呈阳性，其中包括引起鼠疫的细菌。该监管机构说，她死于来源不明的肺炎。肺炎可由多种病毒、细菌和真菌引起。 The World Health Organization is still seeking to understand the “causative agent” of the fatal pneumonia, whether or not it was the plague, Maria Van Kerkhove, the W.H.O.’s director of epidemic and pandemic management, said at a news conference on Wednesday. 世界卫生组织负责流行病和大流行病管理的主任玛丽亚·范凯尔克霍夫周三在新闻发布会上表示，世卫组织仍在设法查明这起致命肺炎病例的“致病因子”，包括确认它是否由鼠疫引起。 “If that is ruled out — they say that is ruled out — what did she actually die from?” Ms. Van Kerkhove asked. “如果鼠疫的可能性被排除了——他们说已经排除了——那么她究竟是因为什么死的？”范凯尔克霍夫问道。 Experts said they believed that with modern testing technology, the Russian authorities should know the answer by now. 专家表示，他们认为，凭借现代检测技术，俄罗斯当局现在应该已经知道答案。 “Presumably, they have the capability within days to do a simple genome sequence,” said Raj Panjabi, who served as a White House public health official during the Biden administration. “Presumably, they’ve done that, but they’ve not shared the results, and that’s concerning.” “按理说，他们有能力在几天内完成简单的基因组测序，”拜登政府时期曾担任白宫公共卫生官员的拉杰·潘贾比说。“按理说，他们已经做了测序，但没有公布结果，这令人担忧。” The lingering questions reflect a broader lack of global public trust that stems in part from unanswered questions about the origins of the Covid-19 pandemic. 这些挥之不去的疑问反映出全球公众普遍存在的信任缺失，而这种不信任在一定程度上源于新冠疫情的起源至今仍未得到解答。 More than six years after Covid upended the world, questions remain about whether the lab that was studying bat coronaviruses in the Chinese city where the pandemic started played a role in the outbreak. China swiftly rejected the possibility and impeded a global investigation into the matter. 新冠疫情给世界带来巨大冲击，六年多过去了，人们仍有诸多疑问尚未得到解答，其中包括：在疫情最初暴发的那座中国城市，一家从事蝙蝠冠状病毒研究的实验室是否与疫情暴发有关。中国迅速否认了这种可能性，并阻碍国际社会对此展开调查。 In Russia, any possible case of a pathogen escaping a lab attracts outsize attention globally in part because the country is one of the few in the world that continues to work on biological weapons, according to the U.S. intelligence community’s annual threat assessment. 在俄罗斯，任何一起疑似病原体从实验室泄漏的事件都会引起国际社会的高度关注。部分原因是，根据美国情报界的年度威胁评估，俄罗斯是世界上少数几个仍在开展生物武器研究的国家之一。 That has led to greater concern among officials and experts in the United States, who point to the nation’s vulnerabilities. 这加剧了美国官员和专家的担忧，他们指出，美国在应对这类威胁方面存在薄弱环节。 “The United States does not have a licensed plague vaccine,” said Andrew Weber, a senior fellow at the Council on Strategic Risks and a former Pentagon official in charge of biodefense. “Given that Russia has an illegal bioweapons program, it is very concerning.” “美国没有获得许可的鼠疫疫苗，”战略风险委员会高级研究员、曾在五角大楼负责生物防御事务的安德鲁·韦伯说。“鉴于俄罗斯有一个非法生物武器项目，这非常令人担忧。” There is no indication that the Irkutsk institute was doing bioweapons research, people briefed on U.S. intelligence said, speaking on the condition of anonymity to give a candid assessment. 听取过美国情报简报的人士表示，没有迹象表明伊尔库茨克的这家研究所正在开展生物武器研究。这些人士要求匿名，以便坦率地作出评估。 Ms. Shipilova was involved in testing which antibiotics and doses worked against Y. pestis, the bacterium that causes the plague, according to the summary of a study presented this year at a Moscow infectious disease conference. 根据今年在莫斯科一场传染病会议上发表的研究摘要，希皮洛娃参与了针对鼠疫耶尔森菌的研究，测试哪些抗生素及多大剂量能够有效对抗这种引发鼠疫的细菌。 The plague, which is endemic to Siberia and some other regions of the world, caused the “Black Death” that ravaged Eurasia in the 14th century, but it is treatable with antibiotics if caught quickly. Pneumonic plague is considered the most dangerous of the three main forms of infection, because it spreads from person to person and causes deadly, rapid-onset pneumonia. 鼠疫在西伯利亚和世界其他一些地区属于地方性流行病。14世纪肆虐欧亚大陆的“黑死病”就是由鼠疫引起的，但如果及早发现，可用抗生素治疗。肺鼠疫被认为是鼠疫三种主要感染类型中最危险的一种，因为它可以在人与人之间传播，并迅速引发致命性肺炎。 Referring to Ms. Shipilova as “the patient,” the Russian authorities have said that she was vaccinated against the dangerous microorganisms she was working with, and that two reviews of the institute ruled out any “emergency situations” at the lab. The quarantine measures that the Russian authorities took in the Irkutsk region were put in place out of caution, owing to the nature of the patient’s work, they said. 俄罗斯当局将希皮洛娃称为“患者”，并表示她已经接种了针对其工作中接触的危险微生物的疫苗，对研究所进行的两次调查也排除了实验室存在任何“紧急情况”。他们说，之所以在伊尔库茨克地区采取隔离措施，是考虑到患者的工作性质，出于谨慎而采取的预防措施。 Plague vaccines have long existed, but experts have raised serious doubts about their effectiveness and safety. 鼠疫疫苗早已问世，但专家对其有效性和安全性一直存在严重质疑。 Beyond what pathogen led to Ms. Shipilova’s pneumonia, many other questions remain unanswered, including where she was in the days leading up to her death, what she was working on at the institute at the time, and how and when her illness first showed itself and then progressed. 除了是什么病原体导致希皮洛娃患上肺炎之外，还有许多问题没有答案，包括她去世前几天在哪里、当时在研究所做什么，以及她的病症最初何时出现、有哪些表现，之后又是如何发展的。 Labs around the world working with deadly germs take extensive precautions to keep workers from being infected, but accidents have occurred. 世界各地研究致命病原体的实验室都会采取严格的防护措施，避免工作人员受到感染，但事故仍有发生。 Though Russia took swift action to quarantine and test individuals who had come into contact with the researcher, Rospotrebnadzor has not held any news briefings and has provided information only in periodic public statements. The Kremlin has declined to field specific questions, urging the public to listen only to public health officials. 尽管俄罗斯迅速采取行动，对与这名研究人员有过接触的人实施隔离和检测，但俄联邦消费者权益保护和公益监督局没有举行过任何新闻发布会，只是不定期发布公开声明。克里姆林宫则拒绝回答具体问题，敦促公众只听取公共卫生官员发布的信息。 Russia has been slow to reveal the details of other incidents with possible public health implications. 对于其他可能影响公众健康的事件，俄罗斯也曾迟迟不肯披露相关细节。 In 2019, Moscow concealed critical information about the failed underwater recovery of a nuclear-powered missile in the White Sea, which caused an explosion and left seven people dead. The authorities did not initially say that a nuclear device was involved, acknowledge a spike in radiation or warn doctors that they were treating irradiated patients. 2019年，俄罗斯在白海打捞一枚核动力导弹失败，引发爆炸，造成七人死亡。莫斯科隐瞒了这一事件的关键信息。俄罗斯当局最初既没有说明事件涉及核装置，也没有承认辐射水平曾急剧上升，更没有提醒医生，他们正在救治的患者受到了辐射。 Nondisclosure has long been the modus operandi of the Soviet and now Russian bureaucracy, said Alexander Kelle, a senior researcher at the Institute for Peace Research and Security Policy at the University of Hamburg in Germany. He cautioned against reading too much into the paucity of details. 德国汉堡大学和平研究与安全政策研究所高级研究员亚历山大·凯勒表示，不披露信息长期以来一直是苏联乃至如今俄罗斯官僚机构的惯常做法。他提醒人们，不要因为披露的细节有限就过度解读。 “Just because there is a lack of information, we have to be careful not to equate that with something nefarious,” Mr. Kelle said, noting that there were many legitimate public health reasons for researchers to work on dangerous pathogens. “正因为信息缺乏，我们就必须谨慎，不能因此认定背后有什么不可告人的勾当，”凯勒说，并指出研究人员研究危险病原体有许多正当的公共卫生理由。 To posit any link to Russian biowarfare, he said, would “be stretching the very limited evidence that has been presented too far.” 他说，如果据此推断这起事件与俄罗斯的生物战研究存在任何联系，那就“远远超出了目前极其有限的证据所能支持的范围”。 In a video message on Thursday, the governor of the Irkutsk region, Igor Kobzev, sought to close the book on the episode. He said that the medical monitoring of people in the region had concluded and thanked his fellow Russian officials for taking swift action under intense scrutiny. 伊尔库茨克州州长伊戈尔·科布泽夫周四发布视频讲话，试图为这一事件画上句号。他说，对该地区相关人员的医学监测已经结束，并感谢俄罗斯其他官员在受到密切关注的情况下迅速采取行动。 Mr. Kobzev said the W.H.O. had publicly confirmed that there were no risks to public health, though the organization has said it has not received enough information from Russia to make a risk assessment. 科布泽夫称，世卫组织已公开确认不存在公共卫生风险。然而，世卫组织表示，尚未从俄罗斯获得足够的信息，无法进行风险评估。 Some people commenting on Mr. Kobzev’s video in his Telegram channel weren’t having it. 但在科布泽夫的Telegram频道上，一些给他的视频留言的人并不买账。 “What caused the pneumonia that killed the healthy young woman?” one asked. “究竟是什么引发了肺炎，夺走了这名健康年轻女性的生命？”一人问道。 “Are there really still naïve, gullible people in our city who would believe this?” another commenter said. 另一名评论者说：“难道我们这座城市里真的还有这么天真、这么轻信别人的人，会相信这一套吗？” A third wrote: “X-Files, nothing to see here.” 还有人写道：“简直就是《X档案》：没什么好看的，都散了吧。” K.
